en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When you enshroud the deceased, so scatter upon every cloth, something from the fragrant powder and camphor’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When you shroud a deceased, scatter fragrant powder and camphor on every piece of the shroud.’”
